coverage.subtopic: Increased fixed outflow resistance and the left ventricular pressure-volume loop
coverage.learning_objective: Fixed aortic outflow obstruction increases left ventricular afterload, systolic pressure, and end-systolic volume while reducing stroke volume.

coverage.subtopic: Respiratory ventricular interdependence and pulsus paradoxus
coverage.learning_objective: Cardiac tamponade exaggerates ventricular interdependence: inspiratory right ventricular filling displaces the septum leftward and lowers left ventricular preload and systolic pressure.

coverage.subtopic: Preload-dependent left ventricular outflow tract obstruction
coverage.learning_objective: Dynamic obstruction in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy worsens when preload falls because the smaller ventricular cavity promotes systolic anterior motion of the mitral valve.

coverage.subtopic: Dual AV nodal pathways and initiation by a premature atrial impulse
coverage.learning_objective: Typical AVNRT begins when a premature atrial impulse is blocked in a refractory fast pathway, conducts antegrade through a slow pathway, and returns retrograde through the recovered fast pathway.

coverage.subtopic: Autonomous aldosterone secretion, renin suppression, and distal nephron ion transport
coverage.learning_objective: Primary hyperaldosteronism causes sodium retention with renin suppression and increases distal potassium and hydrogen ion secretion, producing hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis.

coverage.subtopic: Serum potassium redistribution despite total-body potassium depletion
coverage.learning_objective: In diabetic ketoacidosis, extracellular potassium may be elevated despite total-body depletion because insulin deficiency and hyperosmolality shift potassium out of cells while osmotic diuresis causes urinary loss.

coverage.subtopic: Estrogen-induced thyroxine-binding globulin elevation and total hormone increase
coverage.learning_objective: Estrogen-induced elevation of thyroxine-binding globulin raises total thyroid hormone during pregnancy while the active free fraction remains near the gestational reference range.

coverage.subtopic: 21-hydroxylase deficiency with salt wasting and androgen excess
coverage.learning_objective: Severe 21-hydroxylase deficiency decreases cortisol and aldosterone, increases ACTH and 17-hydroxyprogesterone, and diverts precursors toward androgen production.
